difference: libc++, GNU libstdc++ and other STLs are mutually ABI-incompatible; all dependencies must use one STL; std::string layout is an explicit example
platform_applicability: Applicable ABI principle; Android/Bionic-specific packaging details are not applicable to Tizen/glibc

difference: multiple static C++ runtimes can duplicate global state, lose cross-DSO exceptions, corrupt cross-runtime allocation and break cout buffering
platform_applicability: Applicable to mixed/static runtime boundaries; this project mainly targets shared libc++, so only exception/ODR boundary applies

difference: ABI flags, vendor configuration, layout and TU mixing guarantees are configuration-dependent; forward compatibility is not generally guaranteed
platform_applicability: Directly applicable to the platform-built libc++ and its custom ABI flags

difference: stable ABI v1 and unstable next ABI are selected at build time; internal _LIBCPP_ABI_* switches alter ABI
platform_applicability: Directly applicable; current source/binary identity must include configuration, not only version

difference: libstdc++ carries old and std::__cxx11 string/list ABIs in one SONAME; not every layout change is visible in a mangled name
platform_applicability: Directly applicable because released Tizen DSOs expose std::__cxx11 references

difference: GLIBCXX/CXXABI symbol-version families preserve forward compatibility but not reverse compatibility
platform_applicability: Directly applicable to GLIBCXX-versioned prebuilt components

difference: tzdb update, Unicode terminal detection, filebuf setbuf and stringbuf initialization have documented implementation choices
platform_applicability: Mostly applicable; terminal and filebuf behavior use glibc/POSIX substrate on this platform; not evidence of a defect

difference: libc++ can pair with libc++abi, system libc++abi, libcxxrt, libstdc++, libsupc++ or vcruntime; runtime pairing changes available behavior
platform_applicability: Directly applicable; this project uses libc++abi plus libgcc_s, a non-default combination compared with common LLVM libunwind deployments

difference: std::atomic layout/alignment differs with compiler and library combination; libc++ built with GCC takes a different path
platform_applicability: Potentially applicable because platform compiler/runtime combinations differ; exact affected atomic types in 371 packages not measured

difference: clang driver/package search paths may silently select libstdc++ unless libc++ library paths/options are complete
platform_applicability: Applicable to buildroot/toolchain configuration; manifests immediately at link/load identity checks

difference: Chromium Linux migration exposed build failures, GPU breakage/revert and changed static-initializer placement
platform_applicability: Applicable migration experience on Linux/glibc; Chromium's bundled toolchain and no-exception policy differ from Tizen

difference: deque block size, retention and allocation behavior differ among libc++, libstdc++ and MSVC
platform_applicability: Applicable standard-conforming behavior difference; not an ABI defect and no platform package impact count available

difference: static ABI library configuration can duplicate/misbind iostream runtime state and crash during initialization
platform_applicability: Potentially applicable only to static ABI runtime or duplicate runtime topology; target product uses shared libraries

difference: associative lookup behavior with non-strict-weak-ordering inputs differs from other implementations
platform_applicability: Applicable only to programs outside comparator preconditions; package impact NOT_OBSERVED
